            About Me
            I am a researcher at MDRC
            based in San Francisco. I use mixed methods to study
            criminal justice reform and anti-poverty programs.
            Before MDRC, I graduated with a B.A. in a program at the
            intersection of sociology, ethnic studies, and history from
            Duke University. Read more about it here.
            Outside of research, I love going to jazz concerts,
            reading, and exploring the Bay Area’s amazing scenery.
